sub_service: Garbage collection complaint via Jodhpur Municipal Corporation's Commissioner contact
description: jodhpurmc.org (Jodhpur Municipal Corporation's own domain) returned empty content with no charter/SLA found via WebSearch, confirmed in a prior round -- not retried. New angle: Rajasthan's statewide Local Self Government (LSG) portal hosts a ULB-Jodhpur sub-site (lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in, a genuinely different, working domain) which names a real Commissioner as the nodal officer with direct phone and email. However, the sub-site's own 'Citizen Charter', 'Feedback / Grievances', and 'Nagar Palika Telephone List' pages were all checked and are unpopulated content templates (last updated 28/03/2016) -- each shows only the same repeated nodal-officer contact box, with no service table, SLA, or category-specific routing of any kind for waste & sanitation. A separate portal, urban.rajasthan.gov.in/mcjs, was also checked and is a bare, contentless page fragment. The Jodhpur Development Authority (JDA, jdajodhpur.org) was checked as a distinct authority per instruction, but its own domain has an expired TLS certificate (a genuine access barrier, not a content issue), and JDA's statutory remit (urban planning/development, land, building permissions) doesn't cover routine civic complaints like waste & sanitation in the first place -- not used.
procedure: Contact the Commissioner's office by phone or email; the source page offers no category-specific routing beyond this single general contact.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for waste & sanitation complaints specifically -- the contact is real and confirmed, but no published numeric response/resolution time exists on any reachable Jodhpur Municipal Corporation page for any category.
contact_information: Commissioner Hari Singh Rathore: 0291-2651464. Email: mcjodh.lsg@rajasthan.gov.in.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on this page.
